issues.problem: pt-teiru explain listed 住む among instantaneous change verbs; 住む is not instantaneous (住んでいる is a continuing state of residence), so the classification would mislead.
issues.action: Removed 住む from the list of instant change verbs.

issues.problem: pt-hajimeru rule said 出す is 'beyond control'; 急に走り出す can be volitional. The real limit is a sudden, unplanned onset (hence no requests or plans), as the explain already says.
issues.action: Rule reworded to '(a sudden, unplanned start)'.
